children: was caught off guard by the proposed US tariffs, its chief executive said on Thursday, although he added that the measures would have no impact on the company this year because any implementation would likely only take effect in 2027.
On Wednesday, the US proposed adding new tariffs on goods from Brazil, including a 10% duty on finished aircraft.

"The E175 is currently the most-flown aircraft in the United States, and more than 40% of its content is sourced from the US. Imposing a tariff on this aircraft would penalize airlines by forcing them to pay more for the plane. That cost would likely be passed on through higher ticket prices and could even contribute to inflation," CEO Francisco Gomes Neto told reporters in Brasilia.

title: Brazil's Embraer CEO says US aircraft tariff will hurt airlines
